name: com.evernote.android.job.patched.internal.JobBootReceiver
description: The patched Evernote Android Job library bundled with Yandex MapKit restores saved background tasks after device boot, quick boot, or an app update; MapKit uses these jobs for offline-map downloads.
disableEffect: After a reboot or update, Yandex MapKit's scheduled offline-map downloads may not resume.
